title: Proverbs Chapter 3 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 3 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 3 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 3.

questions.question: What should you not forget according to Proverbs 3:1?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:1 states, 'My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments.' This clearly indicates that the law should not be forgotten.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:2, what shall length of days and peace add to you?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:2 mentions that 'length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.' This confirms that long life is one of the benefits.

questions.question: What should not forsake you as per Proverbs 3:3?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:3 instructs, 'Let not mercy and truth forsake thee.' This is a direct command to keep mercy and truth close.

questions.question: What is promised in Proverbs 3:4 for those who follow the commandments?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:4 states, 'So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man,' showing the benefits of obedience.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 3:5 instructs us to lean on our own understanding.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:5 says, 'Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding,' clearly indicating we should not lean on our own understanding.

questions.question: What should you acknowledge in all your ways according to Proverbs 3:6?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:6 instructs, 'In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths,' emphasizing the importance of acknowledging the LORD.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 3:8 states that keeping wisdom will bring health.
questions.explanation: In Proverbs 3:8, it is said, 'It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones,' confirming that wisdom brings health.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:9, what should you honor the LORD with?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:9 commands, 'Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase,' stressing the importance of honoring the LORD with material possessions.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:11 say about the chastening of the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:11 states, 'My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction,' instructing us not to despise His correction.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 3:12, the LORD corrects those He loves.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:12 confirms, 'For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth,' indicating that correction is a sign of love.

questions.question: In what order should one act according to Proverbs 3:7 and 3:8?
options: Fear the LORD, then gain health
Gain health, then fear the LORD
Lean on your own understanding, then acknowledge the LORD
Trust in your wisdom, then seek peace
questions.correctAnswer: Fear the LORD, then gain health
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:7 advises to 'fear the LORD, and depart from evil' before mentioning the health promised in verse 8.

questions.question: What is said to be more precious than rubies in Proverbs 3:15?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:15 states, 'She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her,' referring to wisdom.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 3 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 3 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:13 say about the man who finds wisdom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:13 states that 'Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.' This highlights the joy that comes from acquiring wisdom.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:14, how does the value of wisdom compare to silver and gold?
options: It is better than silver and gold
questions.correctAnswer: It is better than silver and gold
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:14 explains that 'the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold,' indicating the superior value of wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:15 say about wisdom's worth compared to rubies?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:15 states that 'She is more precious than rubies,' emphasizing that wisdom surpasses even valuable gems.

questions.question: What promise is given in Proverbs 3:16 regarding wisdom?
options: It gives length of days and riches
questions.correctAnswer: It gives length of days and riches
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:16 states, 'Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour,' highlighting the benefits of wisdom.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:17, what are the characteristics of wisdom's ways?
options: They are ways of pleasantness and peace
questions.correctAnswer: They are ways of pleasantness and peace
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:17 describes wisdom's ways as 'ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace,' indicating the positive nature of following wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:18 say about wisdom for those who hold on to it?
options: It is a tree of life
questions.correctAnswer: It is a tree of life
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:18 states, 'She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her,' illustrating the sustaining and life-giving nature of wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:21 instruct the reader to keep in their eyes?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:21 advises, 'let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion,' emphasizing the importance of focusing on wisdom.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:23, what will happen when you keep wisdom and discretion?
options: You will walk safely and not stumble
questions.correctAnswer: You will walk safely and not stumble
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:23 states, 'Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble,' indicating the protective nature of wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:24 promise about sleep for those who follow wisdom?
options: It will be filled with nightmares
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:24 assures, 'when thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet,' highlighting peace brought by wisdom.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 3:11, the Lord's chastening is a sign of His love.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:12 states, 'For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth,' showing that correction is an expression of love.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 3:29 encourages devising evil against your neighbor.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:29 states, 'Devise not evil against thy neighbour,' clearly instructing against such actions.

questions.question: True or False: Envying the oppressor is encouraged according to Proverbs 3:31.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:31 warns, 'Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways,' indicating that envy is not advisable.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 3 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 3.

questions.question: What shall be added to those who keep the commandments according to Proverbs 3:2?
options: Length of days, long life, and peace
questions.correctAnswer: Length of days, long life, and peace
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:2 states that keeping the commandments will result in 'length of days, and long life, and peace.'

questions.question: Which virtue is said to be more precious than rubies in Proverbs 3:15?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:15 explicitly states that wisdom is 'more precious than rubies.'

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:26, who shall be your confidence?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:26 clearly states, 'For the LORD shall be thy confidence.'

questions.question: What should one not be afraid of according to Proverbs 3:25?
options: Sudden fear and the desolation of the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: Sudden fear and the desolation of the wicked
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:25 advises, 'Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.'

questions.question: In Proverbs 3:28, what should you not say to your neighbor when you have the ability to help?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:28 warns against saying to your neighbor, 'Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give.'

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 3:33, the LORD blesses the habitation of the wicked.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:33 states, 'The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.'

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:32, who has the secret of the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:32 indicates that 'his secret is with the righteous.'

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Proverbs 3:5-6, presenting a contrast between trusting God and relying on one's own understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:5-6 exemplifies parallelism by contrasting 'trust in the LORD' with 'lean not unto thine own understanding.'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:18 refer to wisdom as?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:18 describes wisdom as 'a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her.'

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 3:34, God gives grace to the proud.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:34 states, 'but he giveth grace unto the lowly,' indicating grace is given to the humble, not the proud.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of trusting in the LORD from Proverbs 3:5?
questions.explanation: Philippians 4:6-7 encourages believers to trust in God, paralleling the message of trusting the LORD from Proverbs 3:5.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:30, what should one avoid doing to others?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:30 advises, 'Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.'

questions.question: What is the reward for the wise according to Proverbs 3:35?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:35 states, 'The wise shall inherit glory.'

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 3 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 3 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:2 promise will be added to those who keep God's commandments?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:2 states that keeping the commandments will add length of days, long life, and peace, indicating the blessings that come from obedience to God's law.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:5, in whom should one trust?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:5 instructs to trust in the LORD with all one's heart, highlighting the need for dependence on God rather than self-reliance.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:11 say about the chastening of the LORD?
options: It is a sign of God's love
questions.correctAnswer: It is a sign of God's love
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:11 explains that the chastening of the LORD is not to be despised, as it is a reflection of His love, similar to how a father corrects his son.

questions.question: What is said to be health to thy navel and marrow to thy bones in Proverbs 3:8?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:8 indicates that following wisdom and understanding leads to health and vitality, illustrating their essential role in a well-lived life.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 3:33, what is the curse of the LORD in relation to the wicked?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:33 states that the curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked, contrasting with the blessings given to the just, emphasizing God’s justice.

questions.question: What should be done with mercy and truth according to Proverbs 3:3?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:3 encourages one to let not mercy and truth forsake them, but rather to bind them about their neck, symbolizing their importance in the follower's life.

questions.question: What is promised in Proverbs 3:10 for those who honor the LORD with their substance?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:10 states that honoring the LORD with substance and firstfruits will result in barns filled with plenty, reflecting God's provision for those who are faithful.

questions.question: In Proverbs 3:19, what did the LORD use to found the earth?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:19 reveals that the LORD founded the earth by wisdom, demonstrating His sovereign power and the foundational role of wisdom in creation.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:15 say about wisdom?
options: It is more precious than rubies
questions.correctAnswer: It is more precious than rubies
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:15 emphasizes the unmatched value of wisdom, declaring it more precious than rubies, highlighting its importance in life.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Proverbs 3:5-6 and Proverbs 3:7 convey about human understanding?
options: It is sufficient for all decisions
It must be submitted to God
questions.correctAnswer: It must be submitted to God
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:5-6 encourages trust in the LORD and acknowledges His guidance, while Proverbs 3:7 warns against relying on one's own wisdom, together teaching the need for divine submission.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:17 say about the ways of wisdom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:17 describes the ways of wisdom as pleasant, showing that following God's wisdom leads to a fulfilling and joyful path.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:26 promise about the LORD?
options: He will keep your foot from being taken
questions.correctAnswer: He will keep your foot from being taken
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:26 assures that the LORD will be the confidence of the believer and will safeguard them from harm, emphasizing His protective nature.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 3:28 instruct us to treat our neighbor?
options: Withhold good when it is due
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:28 instructs not to delay in doing good when it is within one's power to help, emphasizing the importance of acting with kindness and generosity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 3:34 say about the lowly?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:34 highlights that God gives grace to the lowly, contrasting their status with the scorners who are scorned by the LORD, showing God's favor towards the humble.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that wisdom is unattainable for common people. What does Proverbs 3:13-14 actually teach?
options: Wisdom is only for the rich
Wisdom is a gift from God
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:13-14 teaches that happiness comes to the one who finds wisdom and gains understanding, reinforcing that wisdom is accessible and valuable to all who seek it.
